verdict.rationale: FreshBooks documents a REST API with OAuth 2.0, reports, journal entries, expenses, payments and an SDK. That is a developer building block an external agent could be wired to, not a FreshBooks capability for asking an agent affordability questions grounded in ledger data. The pack shows no first-party AI assistant, MCP server or agent-oriented docs (llms.txt returns 404), and no cash-position or balance endpoint is evidenced for answering "can we afford X?".

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can ask an agent "can we afford X?" and get an answer grounded in live ledger data pulled through the API
